resources.string: Vogel Vault
Convex row data unavailable
Convex row tables over HTTP did not return usable data. This state combines request rejection, network failure, malformed or incomplete responses, and row decode failure.
Showing stale data
The last successful Convex row response is old. Treat these figures as out of date.
Loading Convex rows
Requesting Convex row tables over HTTP.
No rows returned
Convex returned an authoritative empty result for this view.
Convex read token not accepted
Convex could not authorize row reads. This state combines a missing read token with a token the server rejected. Cached financial figures are hidden.
Convex row reads are not active
No read token is configured, or remote reads are disabled; this screen cannot distinguish those states. Figures are sample data.
A Convex read token is stored securely.
No Convex read token is stored. Row reads are unconfigured.
Remove stored token
The stored read token could not be removed.
Convex returned targets for %1$s. Actuals were re-derived from %2$s transaction rows; the targets were not.
The Convex transaction rows have no matching budget category, so this spend is counted on Activity only.
More
Refresh live data
Refresh unavailable while live reads are disabled
Refresh failed
Live reads did not complete. Check the connection and read-token settings, then try again.
